title: Hoelder-coefficient algebra: |L| <= t K I^(1-1/p) implies |L/t^(n+1)/(1 + I/t^n)| <= K t^(-n/p) (parent step 3)
statement: Let n be a natural number and p, t, K, I, L real numbers with p > 1, t > 0, K >= 0 and I >= 0. If |L| <= t K I^(1 - 1/p) (real power), then |L / t^(n+1) / (1 + I/t^n)| <= K t^(-(n/p)) (real power), where t^(n+1) and t^n are natural-number powers.
